segments.description: The shares in display order: { id, label, value, color? }. Shares are each value over the total of the visible segments; zero and negative values are left out. Segments are matched by id when the data changes.

title.description: Heading above the bar and the accessible name unless label is set.

format.description: Number format for values in the readout, such as currency for a budget. Shares always read as percentages with one decimal.

unit.description: Word after values in the readout, such as sessions.

totalLabel.description: Label of the readout when nothing is highlighted.

hidden.description: Ids of segments that are switched off (controlled).

onHiddenChange.description: Called with the new list when the legend or the keyboard switches a segment.

legend.description: Show the legend. Each item toggles its segment and highlights it on hover.

locale.description: Formatting locale. Fixed by default so server and client render the same digits.

label.description: Accessible name. Defaults to the title.

style.description: Inline styles on the root element.
